chunks.text: Welcome to the Slow English podcast.
In this podcast, we speak slow and easy English.
We talk about a very special city.
The city is Matera.
Matera is in Italy.
Italy is a country in southern Europe.
Matera is in the south of Italy.
Matera is famous for its very old houses made in the rocks.
Part two.
Matera is one of the oldest cities in the world.
People have lived there for thousands of years.
Long ago, people made homes in the rock and caves.
These homes are called Sasi.
The word Sasi means stones.
The houses look very unique and interesting.
Part three.
The Sasi area is the most famous part of Matera.
It has many caves, houses, and small streets.
Some homes are built inside the rock.
Visitors often say the city looks like a movie scene.
Part four.
Because of its special history, Matera is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
This means the city is important for world culture.
Many people from different countries visit Matera every year.
They come to see the ancient buildings and beautiful views.
Part five.
Walking in Matera is a special experience.
The streets are narrow and go up and down the hills.
There are many small stairs and stone paths.
Visitors enjoy walking slowly and exploring the city.
Part six.
Many old caves in Matera are now hotels and restaurants.
People can sleep in cave hotels.
Inside the rooms there are modern comforts but the walls are still stone.
This makes the experience very unique.
Part seven.
Matera also has many old churches.
Some churches are inside caves.
The walls of these churches have ancient paintings called frescoes.
These paintings show religious stories and history.
Part eight.
The view of the city is very beautiful, especially at sunset.
The stone houses become golden in the sunlight.
At night the lights from the houses create a magical atmosphere.
Many photographers love taking pictures here.
Part nine.
Food in Matera is simple and traditional.
One famous food is Matera bread.
This bread has a special shape and a strong crust.
People also eat pasta, cheese and vegetables.
Part 10.
Life in Matera is calm and peaceful.
Local people enjoy talking with neighbors and spending time with family.
Many people sit in small cafes and drink coffee.
The atmosphere of the city is warm and friendly.
Part 11.
Matera has become more famous in recent years.
Some movies were filmed there because of the ancient look of the city.
In 2019, Matera was the European capital of culture.
This brought many visitors to the city.
Part 12.
Matera is a city full of history, culture and beauty.
The stone houses, cave churches and quiet streets make it unique.
Visitors can feel the past while walking through the city.
Even though Matera was once little known, today it is one of Italy's most fascinating places.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Amili.
See you in the next episode.
